import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    nums = list(map(int, data))
    n = nums[0]  # not used
    a = nums[1:4]
    b = nums[4:7]

    min_val = (
        max(0, a[0] - b[0] - b[2]) +
        max(0, a[1] - b[0] - b[1]) +
        max(0, a[2] - b[1] - b[2])
    )

    max_val = (
        min(a[0], b[1]) +
        min(a[1], b[2]) +
        min(a[2], b[0])
    )

    print(f"{min_val} {max_val}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
